financial_anchor.caveat: Adjusted operating profit was $8.856bn; MiniMed separation, FX and tariffs confound trends.

ai_claim.claim: GI Genius improved adenoma detection from 46.6% to 59.1% in a 795-patient non-blinded quasi-randomized multicenter study; the expert subgroup was significant, the non-expert subgroup was not.
ai_claim.stage: E3 scoped clinical task with design limits
ai_claim.limitation: NNRR 15.1% vs 17.1% (p=.542) means no statistically significant difference, not equivalence; no mortality, renewal, pricing or cash result.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Independent testing finds surgical vision-language models still struggle with spatial and temporal reasoning.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Research models/datasets are not Medtronic products.

rights_limit: Hospital/patient video and telemetry rights are contract and consent specific; public pages do not establish pooled cross-site training permission.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY26 GAAP operating profit is $323m/year; illustrative net recurring AI contribution is $229m/year.
g2_provisional: Provisional: scoped E3 clinical evidence and E2 products, no group-material retained cash proof.
